**Original comment by agriggio (Bitbucket: [agriggio](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio), GitHub: [agriggio](https://github.com/agriggio)).**

----------------------------------------

…but I don’t see anything wrong. Here’s neutral profile, -2Ev of exposure compensation:

* ART:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/424044978-art-off.jpeg)
* RawTherapee:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/1360583006-rt-off.jpeg)
With highlight recovery in “Blend” mode:

* ART:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/2406846218-art-blend.jpeg)
* RawTherapee:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/413935280-rt-blend.jpeg)
With “colour propagation”:

* ART:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/599308964-art-cp.jpeg)
* RawTherapee:

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/2047473055-rt-cp.jpeg)
The only difference is that in RT you have “clip out of gamut” that is checked by default. This, with no highlight recovery, will simply clip to pure white. But “blend” recovery gives better results… \(ART doesn’t clip out of range values until later in the pipeline, when going from scene- to display-referred mode\).
